title: 10 Best Stellaria Media Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Stellaria media are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and poultices, each offering unique benefits for health and healing. Teas made from dried Stellaria media leaves are commonly used to soothe respiratory and digestive discomfort. Decoctions involve boiling the roots to extract more potent compounds, often used for digestive support. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, useful for quick absorption of its medicinal properties. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gel-like substance, are used to coat and protect the mucous membranes, while poultices apply the herb directly to the skin for topical relief.
